reason: A Web profile plugin that provides warm light, warm dark, and system-aware semantic color themes with configurable warmth and eye-care settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可调节暖度的暖色浅色、深色和系统自适应主题，并通过设置面板管理眼部舒适模式。
summaries.en: Provides configurable warm light, warm dark, and system-aware themes for DSH Web through an Eye care settings panel.

capabilities: Registers six warm light and dark themes
Adds an Eye care settings control
Responds to native appearance and system color-scheme changes
Persists selections in host settings through a loopback connection
Keeps settings process-local for remote browser sessions
